gates.title: Source
gates.description: Lint, docstring coverage, the Python suite and the console unit suite, all measured on the candidate commit.

gates.title: Package
gates.description: The sdist and wheel build, install into a clean venv, expose every declared extra, and pass the suite when the suite runs against the installed wheel rather than the source tree.

gates.title: LangGraph compatibility
gates.description: The pinned LangChain/LangGraph/Agent Server matrix still conforms and the governed-tool benchmark holds against its recorded baseline.

gates.title: Untrusted code execution
gates.description: The sandbox sidecar still refuses what it is required to refuse: argv handling, hardening, and strict-network containment for code the platform did not author.

gates.title: Security regression
gates.description: The reviewed tenant-isolation and hostile-execution matrix completed without skips, every exact node was covered, and observable evidence contains no credential canary or GitHub token.

gates.title: Load and recovery
gates.description: Versioned burst, sustained, soak, overload, and fault profiles hold their candidate-versus-baseline thresholds without losing or duplicating accepted runs.

gates.title: Deployment smoke
gates.description: The release image starts, reports ready, serves the gateway, refuses invalid configuration promptly, drains in-flight work on shutdown, and carries an SBOM plus a verified provenance attestation.

gates.title: Economic debugger acceptance
gates.description: The exact candidate is installed from the published index as a headless package, emits a bounded economic diagnostic, and closes a seeded provider statement to workflow outcomes.

gates.title: Promotion
gates.description: Every preceding gate validated against this candidate, and a named human accepted the release.

junit.description: Machine-readable test results for the suite the gate ran.

compatibility.description: The resolved compatibility matrix the candidate was tested against.

benchmark.description: Governed-tool overhead measured against the recorded baseline release.

source-receipt.description: Atomic binding from exact candidate source and identity to retained raw observations.

security.description: Machine-readable security evidence: credential-leak scan results for the security regression gate and cryptographic verification of release image provenance. This does not claim a vulnerability or dependency scan.

deployment.description: Readiness, gateway, configuration-refusal and shutdown probes against a running deployment.

economic-acceptance.description: Candidate-bound installed-package evidence for the headless diagnostic and provider-bill reconciliation path.

ui.description: Open-source console unit-suite evidence from the shared repository. The console is not installed or published by the headless zeroth-core release.

sbom.description: SPDX software bill of materials for the release image.

provenance.description: Sigstore build-provenance bundle plus its cryptographic verification result.

manual-signoff.description: A named human's recorded acceptance of the candidate. No CI step can produce it; the promotion gate fails closed until an operator writes it.
